name: MMDMA-2
summary: Methyl-MMDA-2, also known as 2-methoxy-4,5-methylenedioxy-N-methylamphetamine or as 6-methoxy-MDMA, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and MDxx families. It is the N-methylated derivative of MMDA-2, and it is also an analogue of MDMA and 6-methyl-MDA.

uses.text: Methyl-MMDA-2 was first synthesized by Alexander Shulgin and was described in his book PiHKAL (Phenethylamines I Have Known and Loved).

summaryZh: 甲基-MMDA-2，分子式C12H17NO3，是一種安非他命類迷幻藥物，可看作2-甲氧基-4,5-亞甲二氧基苯丙胺的N-甲基衍生物或的亞甲二氧甲基苯丙胺的6-甲氧基衍生物。
